description: A broad medium-size isolated plume of pale kitchen steam, several rounded wisps curling upward from an invisible narrow bottom-center emission point. More voluminous than a single thin wisp, but sparse with transparent gaps. Keep the complete plume inside the canvas with generous margins. No pot, pipe or appliance. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 48x64 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
